name: lcit-documentation
description: Claude plugins maintained by the Low Code Integration Team for standardized integration documentation.

plugins.name: integration-diagram-tools
plugins.description: Generate standardized Level 3 integration sequence diagrams (Mermaid) and functional descriptions from existing Mulesoft, Frends, or Boomi integrations, using platform-specific skills (mulesoft-documentation-skill, frends-documentation-skill, boomi-documentation-skill) that share one central set of standards, plus a dedicated skill (create-confluence-documentation) for publishing that documentation to Confluence.
